title: Fei-Fei Li's World Labs Launches Atlas to Build Walkable AI Worlds
summary: Fei-Fei Li's World Labs Launches Atlas to Build Walkable AI Worlds Startup Fortune
body: Fei-Fei Li's World Labs Launches Atlas to Build Walkable AI Worlds Startup Fortune
summaryZh: Startup Fortune报道称，李飞飞创立的World Labs正式推出了名为Atlas的新系统，旨在构建可交互、可漫游的AI三维世界。原始信息显示：Fei-Fei Li's World Labs Launches Atlas to Build Walkable AI Worlds Startup Fortune。该消息由Startup Fortune发布，主题为“Fei-Fei Li's World Labs Launches Atlas to Build Walkable AI Worlds”。其重要性主要体现在：李飞飞旗下World Labs发布了构建3D AI世界的Atlas系统，属于具代表性的前沿模型及系统发布。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
